}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *Powerful VPN Router, Support PPTP Server & Client, :L2TP Server & Client, OpenVPN Server & Client, :WireGuard Server or Client, IPsec Site to Site VPN, :support Zerotier Master & Slave. *Load Balancing Router, Internet Access Control
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7621DAT @880MHz :SoC: Dual-core [[MIPS 1004Kc]] *Flash: 16MB (NOR) [[XMC]] flash *Memory: 128MB (int. DDR3) SDRAM *Network: 5x GbE (WAN/LAN) ports :1x Gigabit WAN Port :3x Gigabit WAN/LAN Ports :1x Gigabit LAN Port *Power Source: 12V/1A via barrel
